methodBasis.principle: Use migration risks/probabilities rather than fixed gross counts; retain municipality-specific age/sex patterns.

county.inMethod: Lulea/municipality total same-county in-migration risk applied only to the population in the rest of its own county, then distributed by the municipality-specific age/sex profile
county.outMethod: municipality age/sex out-migration risk applied to current municipal population

rest_sweden.inMethod: municipality total in-migration risk from other Swedish counties applied to Sweden excluding the municipality's own county, then distributed by the municipality-specific age/sex profile
rest_sweden.outMethod: municipality age/sex out-migration risk applied to current municipal population

international.inMethod: municipality share of national immigration times municipality-specific age/sex distribution
international.outMethod: municipality age/sex emigration risk applied to current municipal population

birthStatus.reason: SCB regional projections stratify population and migration assumptions by Swedish/foreign born. The first risk-flow engine remains age/sex based; birth-status-specific deviations are prepared for a later incremental validation rather than introduced simultaneously.

governance: This configuration is fixed from published SCB methodology before evaluating the new risk-flow candidate. Results from previously consumed holdouts may be used for development diagnostics but not as independent confirmation.

ageProfileSmoothing.method: Shrink the unstable local age-cell residual toward the national age profile and adjacent ages. Direct local weight increases continuously with historical event support and temporal persistence; no outcome-tuned age exceptions.

weights.persistence: abs(mean annual local-minus-national share) / (abs(mean residual) + SD of annual residual)

ageProfileSmoothing.structuralBreakProtection: National age peaks remain through the national prior. Stable municipality-specific deviations retain high direct-local weight, so real discontinuities such as young-adult or retirement-age effects can remain sharp.
ageProfileSmoothing.governance: Diagnostic only until rolling-origin validation shows improvement. No age-specific manual overrides may be added after inspecting forecast outcomes.
